messages.body: Validation now accepts registry metadata/id,parent,changed_factors,data plus historical V00 fields, normalizes legacy model-under-model architecture aliases, crop [H,W], disabled/image_only/ema_derived/identity_diagnostic/motion_phase_correlation aliases, scheduler_only recipe, and supervised_only method. train.py adds explicit --geometry/--geometry-sha256 for real volume data; synthetic route remains bounded. train_volume now executes VolumeTrainingData.sample_batch for labeled+unlabeled only when all manifest/geometry hashes are supplied, records label_reads, and fails closed otherwise.
